summary.text: James B. "Jimmy" Sánchez, a Democrat, has represented District 6 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since March 6, 2023, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born and lives in Hartford, graduated from South Catholic High School, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
Before joining the legislature he served on the Hartford Court of Common Council and worked at the Metropolitan District Commission.
